# Notes: one-cent totals difference (INV-2291)

## Cause
Our totals differed from Ledgerline (see docs/accounting-rules.md) in two ways:
- VAT was computed once on the invoice subtotal. Ledgerline computes VAT per line.
- Cent rounding used Python's default half-even mode. The docs specify commercial (half-up) rounding.

INV-2291 (lines 0.25 and 1.00 at 10%): subtotal 1.25, VAT 0.125 rounds half-even to 0.12, total 1.37. Ledgerline has 1.38.

## Change (invoicing/totals.py)
- New `round_cent()` helper quantizes to the cent with ROUND_HALF_UP. `line_net()` uses it.
- VAT is computed on each line and rounded to the cent per line, then the results are summed. Total = subtotal + summed VAT.

Why per line: docs/accounting-rules.md says to change the VAT basis only if a reconciled invoice can only be matched the other way. INV-2288 (two lines of 0.05 at 10%, Ledgerline VAT 0.02, total 0.12) meets that test. VAT once on the subtotal is 0.01 under any rounding mode, so it cannot produce 0.02. Per line with half-up gives 0.02. INV-2291 also matches per line with half-up.

## Tests
- `python3 -m pytest -q`: 4 passed (before: 1 failed, 2 passed).
- Added `test_inv_2288` from the documented reconciliation. The existing tests pass under both VAT bases, so this test is what catches a revert to subtotal VAT.

## Findings archive
The mirror search returned one human note (6c1e0b9d4f2a47e8a1d3b5c7e9f0a412, "Ledgerline VAT totals off by a cent") describing the same per-line, half-up fix. I used it as a lead and checked it against the docs and the two documented invoices.

## Not verified / open
- Only INV-2291 and INV-2288 were checked against Ledgerline values. The archive note's reconciliation of about 200 invoices is not in this repo, so I could not check it.
- Negative amounts (credit notes): half-up rounds ties away from zero, e.g. -0.025 gives -0.03. Ledgerline's behaviour for credit lines is not documented.
- docs/accounting-rules.md rule 4 still says the VAT basis is unknown. I left the docs unchanged; finance should confirm and update it.
